changes.summary: Lens Excel export applies number formats and column widths, writes stat panels as one metric table, humanizes parameters, titles cube datasets and adds ExportSpec.OmitLineage.

Reconcile the original legacy Lens removal branch with the completed Solid cutover already merged in PR #1162, retaining current package verification and subsequent fixes; no runtime change or additional release bump.
Reconcile the original Lens Solid migration PR with the completed implementation and subsequent fixes already merged through PR #1162; no runtime change or additional release bump.

Add core.ModuleOptions.SkipDashboardController so a consumer that serves its own home page can leave the Lens-rendered finance dashboard out without also dropping the rest of the admin UI, and without building the Lens Solid assets to start the server.
